## The End of Resume Fraud

The National Student Clearinghouse estimates that 78% of employers have caught candidates misrepresenting their credentials. Blockchain verification technology is about to make credential fraud impossible.

### How Blockchain Credentials Work

- University issues a digital diploma as a cryptographic token on a blockchain
- The credential includes: institution, degree, major, GPA, graduation date, honors
- Candidates share a verification link with employers
- Employers verify instantly — no phone calls, no waiting, no fraud

### Current Adoption

| Institution Type | % Issuing Blockchain Credentials |
|---|---|
| Ivy League | 85% |
| Large Public Universities | 45% |
| Community Colleges | 12% |
| Coding Bootcamps | 68% |
| Professional Certifications (PMP, CPA) | 55% |
| International Universities | 22% |

### Impact on Hiring

- Screening speed : Background checks for credentials drop from 3-5 days to seconds
- Global hiring becomes easier : Verify international degrees without country-specific verification services
- Skills portfolios emerge : Beyond degrees, verified skill completions and micro-credentials build richer candidate profiles
- Bias reduction : When credentials are verified, employers can focus on capability rather than institution prestige

### What Employers Should Do Now

- Update your ATS to accept blockchain verification links
- Train recruiters on verifiable credential formats
- Consider accepting verified micro-credentials alongside traditional degrees
- Use skills-based hiring approaches that complement verified credentials

The combination of blockchain credentials and subscription sourcing will make it possible to verify and hire qualified global talent faster than ever.
